run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point energy and gradient calculation for a molecule using ORCA with a specified functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization (relaxation) for a molecule using ORCA with customizable optimizer parameters
run_orca_calculation_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point or optimization calculation with Natural Bond Orbital (NBO) analysis enabled
run_orca_calculation_for_metal_organics: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using UKS and symmetry-breaking blocks
run_parallel_orca_calculation: run an ORCA single-point or optimization calculation parallelized across a specified number of CPU cores
